decisions.reason: The added connector applies to the integrated-board matrix; the source does not change the separate sensor-board connector list or its total count.
The source adds an integrated-board sensor connector but does not change either defined interboard signal connector or its pinout.
The omitted sensor connector is unrelated to the panel power-button connector and PWRON wiring.
The source does not identify or alter the panel reset connector, mounting, or EN-to-GND behavior.
Adding an integrated-board sensor connector does not affect the charge-status LED connector or indication circuit.
The source does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or its I2C operating mode.
The source does not identify the added connector as the PIR interface or change the existing PIR-connector requirement.
The integrated light-sensor connector is distinct from the e-paper backlight power, switching, and PWM interface.
The source does not alter any panel button or slide-switch connector assignment.
Adding a JST connector does not change the sensors' logic levels, level-shifter omission, or external-adapter policy.
The sensor-connector addition is unrelated to the passive buzzer type or approved component selection.
The source does not identify or modify either capacitive-touch connector or GPIO assignment.
